action: 几何报告增补与线性代数旧页整合
scope: Three Section 5 reports, their principal mathematical narratives and selected atomic branches. Elementary proofs are written locally; deep theorems, announced results and deferred branches are distinguished. This is not complete proof coverage of the three chapters.
source_method: Read the official SIAM full-text chapters through the web tool, including theorem hypotheses and reference status. Publisher curl downloads returned HTTP 403; no local source copy or source-file hash is claimed. arXiv records identify alternate versions, not a substitute for the published numbering.

reports.speaker: Uri Bader
reports.title: Higher Property T and Below-Rank Phenomena of Lattices—An Extract
reports.question: 格的实秩如何限制低次上同调和仿射作用的变形？
reports.reading_scope: Published §§1–3: Definition 1.2, Theorem 1.1, Conjecture 1.3, Corollary 1.10, Theorem 2.1 and Theorem 3.1. §§4–7 provide context for the outlook, not new complete proofs.

proof_scope.2D05: Continuous cochain differential and cancellation; the discrete comparison is proved in 2D0H and 2D0I using existing projective-resolution comparison.
proof_scope.2D0B: Quotient Hausdorff criterion; no vanishing theorem inferred from reduced cohomology.
proof_scope.2D0G: Invariant-vector computation proved. Cohomology consequence uses the announced Corollary 1.10.
proof_scope.2D0D: Published survey statement cites Vanishing of group cohomology as in preparation; no complete proof claimed.

deferred: Full proof of higher Kazhdan vanishing and C*-coefficient criterion.
Non-Archimedean Garland method and semisimple product refinements.
Torsion growth, filling inequalities, CAT(0) fixed-point applications and spectral-gap conjectures beyond the narrative.

reports.speaker: Jacob Bernstein
reports.title: Complexity of Submanifolds, Mean Curvature, and Singularities
reports.question: 高斯熵如何在曲率流、奇点拓扑和共形几何之间传递复杂性信息？
reports.reading_scope: Published §§2–5, especially smooth-flow definitions, Theorems 2.5, 2.10, cone density (3.2), self-expander definition (4.1), Theorem 4.1 low-dimensional consequence, and Theorem 5.2.

proof_scope.2E0A: Huisken formula proved for smooth compact boundaryless flows, with entropy monotonicity. No weak-flow extension claimed.
proof_scope.2E0C: Gaussian integral calculated; equality with entropy uses the self-shrinker maximum theorem.
proof_scope.2E0M: Ordinary isotopy consequence of fixed-cone a.c.-isotopy, with strict entropy threshold and 2<=n<=6.
proof_scope.2E0N: Conformal invariance proved; minimal closed submanifold equality cited.

deferred: Weak mean curvature flow, Brakke regularity and complete low-entropy classification proofs.
Optimal density gap constants and conditional results above dimension six.
Relative expander energy, min-max and monotone Morse flow constructions.
Proof of the stable conformal-volume identity.

reports.speaker: Richard Canary
reports.title: Kleinian Viewpoints on Higher Rank Worlds
reports.question: 低维双曲群的边界几何如何推广到高秩矩阵群并产生新的刚性与作用？
reports.reading_scope: Published §§2–6: singular values, divergence, Anosov conditions, Theorem 3.2, Theorems 4.1–4.5, Corollary 5.2, affine deformation construction and Theorem 6.1.

proof_scope.0N0B: Existing real spectral theorem retained and extended to Hermitian matrices; no duplicate spectral-theorem page.
proof_scope.2F0E: Equality of counting and series critical exponents proved; endpoint convergence left unspecified.
proof_scope.2F0I: Virtually isomorphic explicitly allows a finite normal kernel after finite-index restriction.
proof_scope.2F0N: Derivative cocycle and affine action proved; properness is a separate condition.

deferred: Full Anosov boundary construction, quasi-isometric orbit and openness proofs.
Patterson–Sullivan measure construction and hyperconvex rigidity proofs.
Amalgamated combination theorems and their transversality hypotheses.
Bending laminations, relative Anosov groups, algebraic limits and Dehn filling.
Full contraction estimates in proper affine action existence theorems.
